# Sahara Hospitality Suite

> Multi-property hotel management software for hotel groups. It connects the front desk, housekeeping, restaurants, inventory, procurement, finance, HR, security and audit in one system, with role-based access that is enforced on the API rather than in the browser.

## What it does

- Front office: guests and CRM, reservations, check-in and check-out, room status.
- Housekeeping: cleaning tasks, assignment, inspection.
- Restaurant POS: outlet orders and posting charges back to a guest folio.
- Finance: folios, charges, settlement, refunds and reconciliation.
- Procurement and inventory: stock levels, reorder points, purchase requisitions and approvals.
- Maintenance: engineering work orders and asset repairs.
- People: employees, departments and payroll access.
- Security and audit: incident reporting and an immutable activity log.

## Access model

Three levels — corporate, property manager and operational — over four scopes (corporate, property, department, self). Every request is checked against a fine-grained permission and limited to the properties and departments assigned to the account.

## Public pages

- /login — sign in.
- /help — help centre and FAQ.

Application pages (/ and /module/*) are private and require authentication.
